description:
Implement DuckLake open table format support on par with existing Delta Lake
and Iceberg implementations. DuckLake is DuckDB's native open table format
that provides ACID transactions, time travel, and schema evolution.

This integration follows the established pattern for open table formats in
BenchBox, including:
- Format converter for TBL to DuckLake conversion
- Format capability registration with platform support matrix
- Maintenance operations for ACID workloads
- CLI integration for the convert command
- Comprehensive test coverage
